# Openstyle

Openstyle is a free, open source (MIT license) dictation app for macOS on
Apple silicon. Hold a key, talk, let go; it types clean text in the app you
use. Speech-to-text runs locally with MLX models, on your own server, or on a
cloud provider. There is no account, no cloud service, and no telemetry.

Website: https://maheidem.github.io/openstyle/
Source: https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle
Downloads: https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle/releases/latest

## What it does

- Hold your shortcut key, talk, let go. The text appears at your cursor in
  whatever app you were already typing in: editors, browsers, chat clients,
  terminals.
- Optional AI cleanup fixes grammar and punctuation and strips filler words.
- Meetings: Openstyle records your meetings, transcribes them after the call
  and writes a summary. It detects speakers. You can file meetings in folders,
  tag them and search across all meetings. You can pause and resume a
  recording; paused time does not count.
- Ask your meetings: an optional page, experimental and off by default, for
  questions about your meetings. Turn it on in Settings.
- Import: transcribe audio files.
- Vocabulary: teach it your names and terms.
- Cleanup: set how the cleaned text reads.
- Transcriptions: find anything you said.
- Use with your AI agent (MCP): Openstyle has an MCP server for agents on
  your Mac (Claude Code, pi, Codex). An agent can read your meetings,
  transcripts, summaries, folders, Ask threads and dictations. It can change
  meeting items (title, notes, attendees, tags, speakers, summary, enhanced
  transcript, folders, open items) and help with vocabulary, settings and
  model downloads. Open Settings > Agents (MCP) and click "Add to Claude
  Code", "Add to pi" or "Add to Codex". The Stable app registers as
  "openstyle" and the Dev app as "openstyle-dev". The app must run. Every
  delete needs your OK first. No tool reads or writes API keys.

## Where speech-to-text runs

You choose where your voice goes:

- Built into Openstyle: models run on your Mac. Speech: Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR,
  SenseVoice, Whisper. Text: Gemma 4. Add more speech models from Hugging
  Face. Audio stays on your Mac. On first run, Openstyle suggests a model
  that fits your Mac.
- Your own server: use a server with an OpenAI-compatible transcription
  endpoint, for example oMLX. Audio goes to that server. The AI cleanup LLM
  can run inside the app (built-in Gemma 4), or on oMLX, LM Studio or any
  OpenAI-compatible server.
- Cloud provider: use OpenAI, Groq, Deepgram, ElevenLabs and others with your
  own API key. Audio goes to that provider.

## Requirements

- macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later. The published builds are for Macs with Apple silicon (arm64) only.
- On first launch macOS asks for Microphone access, and for Accessibility and
  Input Monitoring access so the app can read the global hotkey and paste into
  other applications.

## Install

1. Download the latest .dmg (Apple Silicon) from the
   https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle/releases page and drag it to
   Applications.
2. Open Openstyle. Builds are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by
   Apple. The app updates itself from inside the app.

## First run

- Setup shows "Recommended for your Mac": a voice model and a text model that
  fit your Mac, in one download.
- "Choose another" lets you use a model on this Mac, your own server or a
  cloud provider.
- "Run setup again" in Settings or the Help menu opens setup again. It does
  not delete your data.
- The Models page is always visible.

## Performance

In tests on an idle Apple silicon Mac, Parakeet transcribed a 3-minute
recording in under a second. Measured October 2026, warm model.

## FAQ

Is Openstyle free?
Yes. Openstyle is free to download. The code is on GitHub under the MIT
license.

Does it work locally, without a cloud account?
Yes. Transcription can run entirely on your Mac with built-in MLX models.
There is no account, no cloud service, and no telemetry.

Which Macs are supported?
Macs with Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. The published builds are for arm64 only.

Does my audio leave my Mac?
Not with a built-in model. With your own server it goes to that server. With
a cloud provider it goes to that provider.

Can I use my own server?
Yes. Speech-to-text needs a server with an OpenAI-compatible transcription
endpoint, for example oMLX. The AI cleanup LLM can run inside the app with
the built-in Gemma 4, or on oMLX, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server.

Does it take meeting notes?
Yes. It records meetings, transcribes them after the call, writes a summary,
and detects speakers. You can pause and resume a recording. You can file
meetings in folders, tag them and search across all meetings.

How do updates work?
Openstyle checks for updates and downloads them in the background. You choose
when to restart. The Stable channel is the default. An optional Dev channel
gives you early builds.
